name: tcit-posts-challenge
description: TCIT Cloud Solutions web developer challenge — Posts app (React/Redux frontend, NestJS/Prisma backend, PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: pnpm --prefix backend install && pnpm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.test:backend: pnpm --prefix backend run test && pnpm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:backend && pnpm run typecheck:frontend
